proposition.claim:
Uniform-weight divergence in Theorem 1.2 and unconditioned Markov-mass divergence in Corollary 5.5(a) do not imply divergence of the actual denominator m(tau appended x0).

The proof counts depths with multiplicity although the defined object is a set union, without aperiodicity in these auxiliary statements.

The c-fat norm bound should be c^(-1/p); the product condition should say ergodic; uniform irreducibility requires r>=2.
